:::{#hero-heading}

I am a postdoctoral [researcher](researcher.qmd) in economics at the Computational Social Sciences and Humanities Laboratory of the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC). I hold a PhD in Economics from the University of Padova and a PhD in Sociology from the Autonomous University of Barcelona.

I am interested in labour markets, public policy, and methods. My research is focused on the application of causal inference and machine learning to the analysis of labour market policies and industrial policies. I have taught data analysis courses using `R`.

## News

- 20/07/26: Our project "Effective Subsidies for Employment Creation" has got [funding](https://elobservatoriosocial.fundacionlacaixa.org/es/-/social-research-call-2026-src-2026) from "la Caixa" Foundation (€ 114K).
- 20/04/26: Our paper "Innovation in the design of labour market policies: new evidence with deep learning" will be presented at the [XVIII Conference on Labour Economics](https://aeet.eu/xviii-jornadas-de-economia-laboral-2026/).

Read old news [here](old_news.qmd).

:::
